title.value: Contextualized Non-local Neural Networks for Sequence Learning
title.justification: The title explicitly mentioned in the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: Contextualized Non-local Neural Networks for Sequence Learning

analysis.description: The paper proposes a novel approach called contextualized non-local neural networks (CN3) which integrates self-attention mechanisms like Transformer with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to improve sequence learning. It addresses challenges in structure of sentences and contextualized word representations by learning task-specific structures dynamically and leveraging rich local dependencies. It demonstrates improvements over competitive baselines across NLP tasks including text classification, semantic matching, and sequence labelling.

type.justification: The paper conducts extensive experiments on ten sequence learning tasks and reports the results, showing the experimental support for their approach.
type.quote: Experimental results on ten NLP tasks in text classification, semantic matching, and sequence labelling show that our proposed model outperforms competitive baselines and discovers task-specific dependency structures.

name.justification: The CN3 model is proposed and introduced as a novel approach combining Transformer and GNNs to enhance sequence learning.
name.quote: Specifically, we propose contextualized non-local neural networks (CN^{3}), which can both dynamically construct a task-specific structure of a sentence and leverage rich local dependencies within a particular neighbourhood.
